title: The upload-preview src guard returned a crafted blob: id verbatim and CodeQL could not see it as a sanitizer, so every avatar and attachment preview was a high js/xss-through-dom alert

source.ref: CodeQL js/xss-through-dom (high) at lib/onboarding/step-registry.tsx:109, predating 2026-09-29 (blame bd0f94756, 2026-09-27); owner ruling 2026-09-29 "Investigate and fix"

detail: FILED AND CLOSED 2026-09-29 on the owner ruling "Investigate and fix". Slated on W2 (foundation, the security lane beside DEF-HARDEN) and pruned from it on close. ADR-1620. MEASURED. CodeQL 2.27.1 (the bundle codeql-action v4 runs), XssThroughDom.ql over the helper, the step registry and the upload-preview callers on main at d332f1335: four alerts, lib/onboarding/step-registry.tsx:109, app/onboarding/form.tsx:198, components/feed/composer.tsx:561, components/support/report-dialog.tsx:254. The path is input.files, then URL.createObjectURL (an extra taint step the query adds), then React state, then . WHAT IS AND IS NOT A HOLE. No script ran: an does not execute javascript:, SVG through is script-disabled, React writes src as an escaped attribute value, and the only values that reach these sinks are a browser-minted blob:/ or the https URL the upload returned (lib/storage/profile-images.ts: public URL plus ?t=). javascript:, vbscript:, data:text/html and protocol-relative //host were already refused. But the helper ended in a PREFIX test, /^(?:blob:|https?:)/, on the parser output, and the URL parser does not escape a blob: URL opaque path: safeUploadPreviewSrc('blob:https://app.local/">') returned that string verbatim, and a blob id with a quote or space, or an https URL with credentials, passed too. And CodeQL models no scheme check as a barrier for this query; the barrier it applies to every taint configuration is a regexp test anchored at both ends with no wildcard term, so the old comment's advice was to dismiss each alert. WHAT CLOSED IT. lib/safe-image-src.ts: safeUploadPreviewSrc returns the parsed value only from inside `if (RE.test(safe)) return safe` for two fully anchored, wildcard-free patterns: blob:http(s)://host[:port]/[a-z0-9-]{1,64} and http(s)://host[:port]/[?] (no credentials, fragment, quote, angle bracket, backtick, space or backslash). Everything else is null, which every caller already renders as initials or nothing. The comment that said to dismiss is replaced by the rule (ADR-1620 section 3: fix, never dismiss). Re-run after the change: zero XssThroughDom results on the same files, and the full security-and-quality suite reports nothing new there. lib/safe-image-src.test.ts adds four cases (real browser and uploader shapes pass; eleven hostile blob ids; fifteen script-bearing, inline or off-origin shapes; nothing returned can open or end an attribute), three of which fail on the old helper.

verify.note: Imports lib/safe-image-src.ts under type stripping: a real blob: preview and a Supabase upload URL pass unchanged, and eight hostile values (a blob id carrying ">, one with an apostrophe, one with a space and <, javascript:, data:text/html, vbscript:, //host, user:pw@host) return null. Then reads the function body: every non-null return sits inside `if (RE.test(safe)) return safe`, and each RE is a literal anchored at both ends with no bare dot, negated class or \S/\W/\D, the only sanitizer shape CodeQL js/xss-through-dom models. Last, the step-registry avatar still paints through the helper. Fails on main at d332f1335 on the first hostile value. Mutation-fired: dropping the blob anchor, widening the id to a dot, adding an unanchored blob return, and hiding the test behind exec() each fail it.
